serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Hobo: Come on man, are you really gonna bitch about it? I already apologized, ok?
You: Of course I’m gonna bitch about it! I could call the police on you because of it, you know?
#Hobo.Face.smug
Hobo: Oh?!~ Police?~ No Please!~ Not the police!~ They would arrest me, give me a nice place to sleep in and warm food!~ Please don’t do it!~
You: Alright, I get the sarcasm.
Hobo: Ahhh!~ I apologize!~ Don’t snitch on me!~ 
#Hobo.Face.normal
You: I got it already! Holy, you are annoying.
Hobo: Listen dude, if I could make it up for you, I would, but as you can see I’m in a little pinch here.
Hobo: Thanks for today, but I can’t promise I will not do some shit again, ok? I just might not have a choice.
You: Well, at least you are telling the truth.
Hobo: I gotta go now and find a new place to spend a night at, who knows when these brats will come back. Bye.
